svg.title: XiaoGao, drawn as a silver-haired elf mage
svg.desc: A chibi elf mage in the style of Frieren: long silver-white hair with a centre part, pointed ears, big green eyes, a white cape with gold trim over a navy tunic, holding a wooden staff with a red gem. She stands beside her speech bubble, and the bubble types out XiaoGao's introduction one character at a time, then keeps a blinking cursor.
